scripts.build: npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/shared && npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/core && npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/api && npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/worker && npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/ops-agent && npm run build -w @zhihu-mvp/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WORKER,OPS,WEB -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/api" "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/worker" "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/ops-agent" "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/web"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n API,WORKER,OPS -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/api" "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/worker" "npm run dev -w @zhihu-mvp/ops-agent"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/core && npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/api && npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/worker && npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/ops-agent && npm run typecheck -w @zhihu-mvp/web
